选一家服务、填好 API Key 就能开始，模型会自动选好。之后随时可以在设置里: Pick a service and paste its API key to get started; the model is chosen for you. You can adjust everything later in Settings.

请先连接 AI 服务，再导入视频。: Connect an AI service before importing a video.

抽样几张画面理解动作与场景。游戏画面、口播较少的内容推荐开启，切分更准；费用略高: Samples a few frames to understand action and scenes. Recommended for gameplay or content with little speech — cuts are more accurate; slightly higher cost. Off sends subtitles only.
默认由 AI 用上面的服务画一张带标题的封面；也可以改用视频截帧。: By default the service above draws a titled cover; you can switch to a video frame instead.
